enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep.

Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit down. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Adjust shirt. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Walk to desk.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Type replies. Answer phone. Speak to colleague. Attend meeting. Take notes. Print documents. File papers. Make phone calls. Write notes. Use computer. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up printouts. Return to desk. Sit down.

Stand up. Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Throw away trash. Walk outside. Walk around block. Return to office. Sit at desk.

Sit at desk. Open computer. Check emails. Make phone calls. Organize files. Attend meeting. Take notes. Write report. Send emails. Talk to supervisor. Use computer. Stand up. Walk to copier. Copy documents. Return to desk. Sit down. File documents. Answer phone.
Stand up. Pack bag. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Stand up. Walk to exit. Tap card. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

Scrape plate into trash. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Rinse pots and pans. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Dry hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using personal computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Watch video. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep.
